```yaml
name: Checks
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          node-version: 22
          pnpm-version: 9

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9
          run_install: true
          cache_dependency_path: pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Create isolate config
        run: |
          cat > isolate.config.json << 'EOF'
          {
            "includeDevDependencies": true
          }
          EOF

      - name: Run pnpm isolate
        run: pnpm dlx @pnpm/cli isolate --config=isolated.config.json

      - name: Trim devDependencies from lockfile
        run: |
          # Remove devDependencies from pnpm-lock.yaml except those of the isolated package
          npm install -g json
          LOCKFILE="pnpm-lock.yaml"
          TEMP_FILE="$(mktemp)"
          
          # Extract the main package's devDependencies
          MAIN_PACKAGE_DEPS=$(grep -A 1000 "^dependencies:" "$LOCKFILE" | grep -E "^[[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z]" | cut -d':' -f1 | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
          
          # Process the lockfile to remove unwanted devDependencies
          awk '
          /^devDependencies:/ { in_devdeps = 1; next }
          /^[[:space:]]*$/ && in_devdeps { print; in_devdeps = 0; next }
          /^[\w]/ && in_devdeps { in_devdeps = 0 }
          /^[\w]/ && !in_devdeps { print }
          in_devdeps && /^[[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z]/ { 
            # Only keep devDependencies that are part of the main package
            if ($0 ~ /.*[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+/) {
              dep_name = $0
              sub(/:[[:space:]]+.*/, "", dep_name)
              gsub(/[[:space:]]+/, "", dep_name)
              if (dep_name in main_deps) {
                print $0
              }
            } else {
              print $0
            }
          }
          !in_devdeps { print }
          ' "$LOCKFILE" > "$TEMP_FILE"
          
          mv "$TEMP_FILE" "$LOCKFILE"

      - name: Verify lockfile integrity
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
```
